metadata.label: Ontario Science and Technology Grade 7 curriculum

ontario-science-g7-all-strands.documentTitle: Ontario Science and Technology Grade 7 - Overall Expectations

standards.summaryText: use a scientific research process, a scientific experimentation process, and an engineering design process to conduct investigations, following appropriate health and safety procedures
standards.officialOutcomeText: use a scientific research process, a scientific experimentation process, and an engineering design process to conduct investigations, following appropriate health and safety procedures

standards.summaryText: use coding in investigations and to model concepts, and assess the impact of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life and in STEM-related fields
standards.officialOutcomeText: use coding in investigations and to model concepts, and assess the impact of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life and in STEM-related fields

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of the practical applications of science and technology, and of contributions to science and technology from people with diverse lived experiences
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of the practical applications of science and technology, and of contributions to science and technology from people with diverse lived experiences

standards.summaryText: assess the impact of human activities and technologies on the environment, and analyse ways to mitigate negative impacts and contribute to environmental sustainability
standards.officialOutcomeText: assess the impact of human activities and technologies on the environment, and analyse ways to mitigate negative impacts and contribute to environmental sustainability
standards.curriculumFocus: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of interactions between and among biotic and abiotic components in the environment
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of interactions between and among biotic and abiotic components in the environment

standards.summaryText: evaluate the environmental and social impacts of the use and disposal of various pure substances and mixtures
standards.officialOutcomeText: evaluate the environmental and social impacts of the use and disposal of various pure substances and mixtures
standards.curriculumFocus: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of the nature of matter, including the properties of pure substances and mixtures, and describe these properties using particle theory
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of the nature of matter, including the properties of pure substances and mixtures, and describe these properties using particle theory

standards.summaryText: analyse personal, social, economic, and environmental factors that should be considered when designing and building structures
standards.officialOutcomeText: analyse personal, social, economic, and environmental factors that should be considered when designing and building structures
standards.curriculumFocus: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of the relationship between structural forms and the forces acting on them
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of the relationship between structural forms and the forces acting on them

standards.summaryText: assess the benefits of technologies that reduce heat loss, and analyse various social and environmental impacts of the use of energy from renewable and non-renewable sources
standards.officialOutcomeText: assess the benefits of technologies that reduce heat loss, and analyse various social and environmental impacts of the use of energy from renewable and non-renewable sources
standards.curriculumFocus: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of heat as a form of energy that is associated with the movement of particles and is essential for many natural processes within Earth’s systems
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of heat as a form of energy that is associated with the movement of particles and is essential for many natural processes within Earth’s systems
